text: You’ve no idea! But I’m not a nurse, thank heaven, I work in the dispensary.” “How many people do you poison?” I asked, smiling. Cynthia smiled too. “Oh, hundreds!” she said. “Cynthia,” called Mrs. Inglethorp, “do you think you could write a few notes for me?” “Certainly, Aunt Emily.” She jumped up promptly, and something in her manner reminded me that her position was a dependent one, and that Mrs. Inglethorp, kind as she might be in the main, did not allow her to forget it.
